Six friends Pahul, Anuj, Kajal, Mudit, Surjit, and Abhinav are having different chocolates among Amul, Ferrero Rocher, Milk Chocolate, Mars Bar, Nestle, White Chocolate but not necessarily in the same order. The cost of each chocolate is multiple of 5 in Rupees and no two chocolates have same price. All friends like different colors among Black, Blue, Green, Pink, Red and White but not necessarily in the same order. A person can have only one brand of chocolates. Kajal has Ferrero Rocher chocolate and its cost is Rs.10 and he doesn’t like White color. Abhinav likes Green color. Anuj did not have Amul or Mars Bar. Surjit has a chocolate which costs Rs.20. The one person who likes Black color has Mars Bar. Pahul has Milk chocolate which costs Rs.25 and he likes Blue color. The cost of chocolate that Mudit have is less than that of Ferrero Rocher. The costliest chocolate is Nestle and its cost is thrice the cost of Ferrero Rocher and Anuj doesn’t have Nestle. The cost of Amul chocolate is 10 Rupees less than the cost of Nestle. The one who likes Pink color has White chocolate. One of the persons have a chocolate which costs thrice the amount of the one who likes Back color.
SWhich among the following colors was liked by the one who has Amul
chocolate?

 Note: Sugar was purchased at a rate of Rs. 52 per kg.

Direction : Read the given information carefully and answer the given questions. Twelve friends are sitting in two parallel rows containing six people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. In row 1 Z, Y, X, W, V and U are seated and all of them are facing north and in row 2 K, J, I, H, G and F, are seated and are facing south, but not necessarily in the same order.
There are four persons sits to the right of I. I’s daughter is immediate neighbor of the one, who faces I. There are one person sits between I’s son and I’s daughter. J is married to U. I’s son-in-law sits third to the left of the one, who faces the person, who is immediate left of Z’s brother. Two persons sit between H and G. I’s brother sits second to the right of I’s sister. H does not sit one of the extreme ends. Z is brother-in law of Y. Z’s father sits second to the right of Z’s brother. V is married to H. only one person sits between Z’s brother and I’s mother. I’s son-in-law does not sit one of the extreme ends. Z’s sister-in-law faces H. Z’s sister-in-law sits third to the left of I’s daughter. K faces V, who sits one of the extreme left end. Y sits third to the right of V. J sits immediate right of the person, who faces I’s wife. I’s mother sits third to the left of the one, who faces the one, who sits immediate right of I’s son in-law. I’s brother-in-law sits fourth to the left of I’s wife. X sits diagonally opposite to the one, who is immediate right of F. Z is the son-in-law of W.
Who sits immediate left of the one, who is the sister-in law of Z?
